Exploring Human–AI Interaction
Beyond Chat.

I’m Yichen Wang.

I earned a master’s degree in Information Science from Cornell University in 2024 and two bachelor’s degrees in Physics and Digital Media from the University of Rochester, graduating with highest distinction.

I worked as a full-stack AI agent developer and later as lead product manager for the WALL-E companion robot.

I’m now exploring how to make human–AI interaction more natural and human-like, especially through AI companions in video games.
